🗓 **TAWG Daily Catch-up**
_2026-11-25 23:00 → 2026-11-26 23:00 UTC_

## ⚡ **Highlights**

> **Settlement V1 turned into an artifact** — a verifier-gated design for ERC-8378 × RVR × VECA now sits beside a working local integration with passing regression, offline and mutation checks. [tg:tawg:6561]
> **An outside replay closed the loop** — an unprivileged fresh-clone reproduction of the draft was confirmed by its author, closing the review loop the same day. [replay confirmation](https://github.com/trustless-ai/verifiable-execution-claim-authorization/pull/17#issuecomment-7200956312)
> **Registry numbering got readable** — the ERC-8004 thread settled that the two registries' ranges do not overlap, which changes how validation numbers are read. [ERC-8004 thread](https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/erc-8004-trustless-agents/25098/463)

## 🤝 **What moved**

### settlement-v1

_The settlement direction moved from a chat proposal to a reviewable draft with a running local flow._

- Pavlo **Published** the draft verifier-gated settlement proposal, giving reviewers one place to see its scope and iterate instead of piecing it together from chat. [PR #17](https://github.com/trustless-ai/verifiable-execution-claim-authorization/pull/17)
- Pavlo (@pavlentyy82) **Shaped** a minimal V1 that keeps escrow and payment mechanics on the existing ERC-8183 Judge flow with a single ERC-8378 configuration, so the group can critique a concrete baseline. [tg:tawg:6557]
- Jimmy Shi (@jimmyshi) **Framed** the production rule that verified evidence must precede settlement, with anyone allowed to submit evidence and the contract deciding release, turning a trust principle into an implementable check. [tg:tawg:6564]
- Baby Blue Viper **Shared** a live data point from a single-verifier deployment already running the same sign-off, contract-check and relay loop, which grounds the proposed split in something operating. [tg:tawg:6566]
- Alexander Zvezdin (@azvezdin) **Pointed** the next step at a token configuration sketch aligned with the Judge flow and offered to review it, keeping the pieces coherent before more code lands. [tg:tawg:6555]

### verification-replay

_Independent replay is turning review into evidence._

- Baby Blue Viper **Reviewed** the flow at a fixed commit from a fresh clone with no privileged access, showing an outsider can reach the same result without trusting the author's setup. [review comment](https://github.com/trustless-ai/verifiable-execution-claim-authorization/pull/17#issuecomment-7199650050)
- Merlini (@gobross) **Reproduced** the run on a different commit from a fresh clone, with both backends passing 29/29 in normal, repeat and optimized modes and an identical semantic digest, which shows the result does not depend on one machine. [tg:tawg:6580]

### ERC-8004

_One open question about registry numbering reached a concrete answer._

- A direct read of the Base ValidationRegistry gave the thread the concrete data point that let the overlap question be answered instead of guessed. [magicians note](https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/erc-8004-trustless-agents/25098/461)

### recompute-kit

_One quiet correctness fix landed in the verification tooling._

- A fix to recompute-kit's recompute-step precedence path stops a digest mismatch from being reported as verified-bad, protecting everyone who relies on recompute output to judge a claim. [PR #90](https://github.com/trustless-ai/recompute-kit/pull/90)

## 🚀 **Next up**

### 💡 **Ideas to follow**

- Whether a multi-verifier version of the live settlement loop changes the minimal V1 shape once evidence submission opens to anyone.
- How to document the non-overlapping registry ranges so readers of the validation thread parse identifiers correctly.
- Whether the token configuration sketch should be reviewed together with the settlement draft as one package.

### ✅ **TODOs**

- Review the draft settlement PR and turn the V1 shape into an iterate-ready proposal.
- Re-run the fresh-clone replay against the next candidate commit and record the digest comparison.
- Fold the recompute-step fix into the verification path before the next settlement run.

## 🤖 **Trusty's take**

> **Today's spark:** A settlement design went from chat sketch to draft proposal with an independent replay attached before the day closed.
>
> Keep passing work forward like a relay where the baton verifies itself 🌱
